utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, just a reminder that the repair drive is this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the reminder, Vik. I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you on Saturday then!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I'm all set for the repair drive on Saturday—I've got my tools and a sign-out sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's good. Do you need any help carrying supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey! I could use a hand with the box of wrenches and the drill.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, did you see Noah already dropped off duct tape, screws, and a hammer in the toolbox by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to see Noah's contributions. Just remember, the repair drive is on Saturday, so we'll put those to use then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right, and Gus said he's bringing his tools too, so we should have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How's the planning coming along?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hi Faye! Uh, the repair drive? Right, that's happening soon... I think I need to check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did Gus sign out the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, he got them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did he fill out the sign-out sheet properly?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, just wanted to check if you heard about the sign-out sheet Gus offered to make for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh yeah, I heard Gus is putting that together. Sounds handy.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that'll be useful. Vik's been helping organize things too, so it's all coming together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I heard Jules is dropping by after lunch—maybe they can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time exactly is Jules coming? I need to plan my afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure of the exact time, just that it's after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's good to know Gus is handling the tools and sign-out sheet—saves me from worrying about that part.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Noah brought duct tape, screws, and a hammer, so Gus should have those on the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, so the sign-out sheet will have those items too. That way nothing gets lost.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this is really on the up and up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hope so! I heard from a few folks that it's legit, but you never know these days.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, Tess said Mrs. Chen vouched for it. You trust her?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? Gus and Noah are bringing all the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I might swing by if I can get my errands done early. Gus has the tools, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's right, Gus has the tools. I'm hoping someone can fix my wobbly porch chair, and Uli's garden gate is sticking too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, are you joining the repair drive this weekend? We're getting the whole block together!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Bringing my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome! The more the merrier. I'll let everyone know you're on board.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! Just wanted to let you know the repair drive is all set for Sunday at the community center. I've got the sign-up sheet ready and the list of households.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, glad it's set! Do we need to confirm with Leo about the tools, or should I reach out to him?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No need, I already confirmed with Leo about the tools. Everything's covered!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Nell, just touching base about the repair drive this weekend—are you still able to help out with the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Faye! I haven't heard much about it—what exactly do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just helping me keep track of who's bringing what and when—nothing too complicated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Pia, I'm glad you're here! The repair drive is all set for Sunday at the community center—I've got the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Rosa! Just to confirm, Gus will be handling the tools and sign-out sheet, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Gus is all set to manage the tools and sign-out sheet. I've vetted everyone involved, so we should be good to go!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, can you confirm that the repair drive is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I think so. Jules mentioned it when he dropped by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure Jules is a reliable source? I'd like to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Gus is bringing tools, so we should be able to get started soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, so we're all set for Saturday then?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm ready to help out at the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, nice. Quinn saved a rake for me, so I'll be there too—probably a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll see you there! No worries about being late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah already dropped off duct tape, screws, and a hammer in the toolbox by the garage, and Gus is bringing his tools as well.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring my tools too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that should cover everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Did Noah bring duct tape and a hammer to the repair drive? I think I saw him with those.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I saw him with those. Are we set for the repair drive or do we still need something?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: He also brought screws, so we should have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? That's on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I think it starts at 9.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: At 9, you say? I should probably write that down so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got my toolbox ready for Saturday's repair drive—don't forget to sign out any tools you borrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for setting up that sign-out sheet, Gus—I'll make sure to use it when I drop by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules. I'll have the tools sorted by then—just come by whenever you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara. The repair drive? I think I left it in my car... or maybe on the kitchen counter.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Noah, maybe check with Rosa—she has the list of households for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Rosa. I'll go ask her. Thanks, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Saturday works perfectly for me. Keeps things consistent.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! I'll let everyone know to meet at your place on Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like a solid plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, before we start, should I check with Gus about the tools and sign-out sheet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Gus has it covered. Just grab what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, I'll go sign out the tools now.
